purpose: Documents how frustration_score is derived from observable arena telemetry instead of treated as a raw label.

telemetry_inputs.meaning: Number of recent failed attempts against current challenge.
Attempts on the current enemy/boss or equivalent challenge.
Best progress percentage before failure; near misses can indicate high effort and possible frustration.
Current player strength after progression and temporary boosts.
Recent reward exposure used for economy/risk guardrails.
How likely the player is to engage with safer optional/training content.
Synthetic dataset field: time committed to the current challenge.
Synthetic dataset field: recent challenge failures.
Synthetic dataset field: player left after a failure.
Synthetic dataset field: hesitation or inactivity after losses.
Synthetic dataset field: repeated close failures.
Synthetic dataset field: player opened help/tutorial content.

components.description: Repeated attempts, repeated losses, and poor completion indicate being stuck.
Enemy effective power exceeds player effective power.
Fatigue/debuff makes the same challenge harder.
Recent consecutive losses increase frustration pressure.
